quotes.text: :class:`pipeline.Pipeline` now raises an `AttributeError` when accessing attributes that are not available on an empty pipeline. It's therefore possible to call `dir` on an empty pipeline.
Check that dir() works on an empty pipeline

summary: `dir(obj)` lists an object's attributes. scikit-learn estimators keep only the attributes for which `hasattr` is true, and `hasattr` treats only an `AttributeError` as "not there". On an empty `Pipeline([])`, attributes that look at the first or last step read `self.steps[0]` or `self.steps[-1]`, which raise `IndexError` on an empty list, so `dir(pipe)` crashed. The fix turns that case into an `AttributeError`.
teaches: Python's attribute protocol in an estimator
title: Calling dir() on an empty Pipeline

whereToLook.hint: Also `classes_`, `n_features_in_` and `feature_names_in_`: every place that reads a step from `self.steps`.
